rooms.brief: Engineering cold storage: insulated pale gray enamel inset panels, muted blue sealing strips, a compact mechanical thermometer and frost-free pressure line at far left, shallow refrigeration return grille along lower right. Clean maintained insulated construction, no frost or food clutter.

Recreation galley: warm ivory wipe-clean steel panels and a little dull brushed metal, narrow warm wood lower kick rail. Small fitted utensil hooks and a closed spice tin rack at far left, a shallow extraction grille and two hanging folded kitchen cloths at far right. Domestic practical warmth, no food illustrations or furniture.

Engineering salvage workshop: dull gray replaceable steel plates, a recessed far-left rack containing three recognizable differently shaped hand tools, far-right worn but maintained parts bins and capped test sockets, muted ochre handling labels. Organized repair work, sparse handled scuffs, no debris.

Recreation observation room: warm desaturated wood panel inserts inside dark pressure steel, dull brass thin joints, tiny reading-lamp housings unlit at extreme ends and a narrow book ledge along the lower left. Quiet contemplative room. Keep both large side window reservations completely blank; do not paint any windows or ocean view.

Engineering current turbine: blue-gray steel pressure panels, large protected pipe couplings at far left, a recessed mechanical flow gauge and conduit at far right, low slotted intake service grilles. Substantial ocean-current machinery, tiny muted ochre markers, no water or moving blades.

Life Support biomass digester: muted olive-gray enamel and charcoal pressure steel, a closed compact green fluid sight cartridge at extreme left, clean capped washdown ports and fitted pipe loops at extreme right, low removable filtration grille. Maintained biological processing, no slime, vines or contamination.

Engineering heat recovery: warm gray pressure steel with restrained dull copper heat pipes routed through narrow outer service columns, two small temperature dials near ends and short heat-exchanger fins in the lower outer bands. Matte metal, useful insulated fittings, no glowing heat.

Engineering diving airlock: charcoal and dull dark steel, black rubber seals, an inset pair of analog equalization gauges and wheel valve at far left, compact interlock latch and closed hose couplings at far right, sparse small safety chevrons. Pressure-resistant marine construction; no diving suits, extra doors or portholes baked in.

Robotics exterior construction drone bay: charcoal steel panels with modest muted cyan service accents, recessed robot-tool charging contacts on far left, protected hydraulic quick couplers and a short neatly clipped tether segment at far right, lower service vent. No yellow machine paint, no drone, no launch platform.

BRINE Core special identity: pearl-white aquatic composite panels framed by fine gray pressure steel, softly curved precision seams, small sealed sensor lenses at outer ends and fine symmetric recessed service gills along lower outer bands. Serene, uncannily precise, restrained muted cyan identification. No face, screen, eyes or decorative glow; no universal industrial rust.

Engineering solar-array support: neutral gray marine steel and muted blue insulating insets, recessed current meter and fuse carrier on far left, protected cable termination plugs at far right and orderly shallow lower cooling vents. Underwater station control equipment, no sky, sun, outdoor panels or space scenery.

Engineering reactor: charcoal-gray heavy pressure panels and dull steel framing, a compact protected brass pressure-valve pair at far left, vertical shielded pipe and closed inspection box at far right, short recessed lower cooling grille bands. Tiny muted ochre reactor service markers. Keep clean central door and side window reservations; no radiation glow.

Engineering battery array: quiet slate-gray insulated steel panels, small recessed fuse carriers and isolation switch at far left, three short insulated bus couplings at far right, lower vent slots and restrained ochre terminal identification. No full battery stacks, no colored glowing charge bars.

Robotics mining drone bay: dark charcoal steel, muted cyan edge identifiers, protected high-current charging sockets at far left, small recessed cleaning-brush holder and capped slurry connector at far right, heavy low access plates. Seabed rover service construction, no yellow machine paint or ore scenery.

Robotics salvage drone bay: charcoal painted steel with muted cyan accents, recessed tether reel cover and recovery hooks at far left, pressure-rated data jack and compact manipulator service-tool slots at far right, quiet broad access panels. No robot body, yellow machine paint or loose hanging wires.

Anomaly gravity loom: dark gray precision pressure panels with selective desaturated plum ceramic insulators, small paired calibration rings recessed at far left, shielded coaxial connectors and miniature unlit dial at far right, fine lower instrumentation vents. Subtly unfamiliar ordered construction, no glowing runes, stars or giant machinery.

Engineering tidal condenser: matte cool gray enamel with restrained desaturated blue coolant markings, protected short condenser pipe loops at far left, small analog pressure dial and flush drain/service plugs at far right, shallow low heat-exchange grille. Clean water-processing station identity, no flowing water or wet sheen.

Life Support mycelium nursery: muted sage-gray washable wall panels, closed small humidity gauge and irrigation manifold at far left, neatly fitted miniature cultivation cartridge rack at far right, low filtered-air vent. Healthy maintained cultivation, tiny earthy material accents, no invasive fungal wall growth.

Life Support hydroponics: pale muted green-gray enamel, far-left compact nutrient dosing valves with two small contained green cartridges, far-right wall-clipped irrigation tube bundle and analog flow meter, lower clean ventilation slots. Crisp utilitarian plant care, no large plants or roots across panels.

Life Support air and water systems: pale gray-green painted panels within steel ribs, recessed oxygen-flow dials and two capped regulator ports at far left, replaceable filter cartridge cover at far right, shallow lower air-return grilles. Dependable maintained medical-clean utilities, no loose tanks or glow.

Recreation crew habitation: warm gray and muted beige acoustic panels, dark pressure-steel structure and narrow warm wood lower rail. A small personal photo frame with indistinct shapes and coat hooks at far left, compact unlit reading lamp and a folded fabric pouch at far right. Lived-in private comfort without clutter, no beds or portraits readable in detail.

Science research laboratory: clean pale enamel plates with muted blue seam labels, compact closed specimen-label dispenser and capped instrument sockets at far left, small precise analog measurement module at far right, lower filtered ventilation grille. Maintained scientific order, no glowing screens or specimen jars in reserved panels.

Science cryogenic chamber: pale gray insulated composite and muted cold-blue seals, far-left paired temperature dials and a compact insulated coolant line, far-right recessed emergency release cover and closed service plug, thin lower defrost grille. Clean medical technology without frost, people or pods.

Science cloning laboratory: warm pale ceramic-enamel panels and muted blue service accents, far-left compact sterile fluid manifold with sealed connectors, far-right narrow cartridge reader and capped calibration socket, low small filtration vents. Precise clinical construction, no bodies, fetuses, horror growth or luminous tanks.

Science quarantine compartment: clean pale gray washable panels with muted blue identity, recessed intercom grille and closed inspection latch at far left, isolated filtered-air module and two pressure-test ports at far right, a very small muted caution tab. Controlled sterile isolation, no biohazard gore or prison bars.

Robotics data archive: dark gray steel with muted cyan identifiers, tiny closed archive-cartridge slots at far left, capped data patch connectors and quiet ventilation grille at far right, low service-access plates. Practical physical data storage, no scrolling numbers or glowing circuitry.

Engineering ore refinery: heavy neutral steel panels with subtly warm gray lining and sparse muted ochre identifiers, protected pressure valves at far left, compact inspection shutter and capped assay fitting at far right, low broad extraction grilles. Maintained industrial processing, no fire, sparks, molten ore or loose rubble.

Engineering storage bay: neutral gray robust steel panels, recessed tie-down loops and two short cargo restraint hooks at far left, small blank inventory card holder and fold-flat bracket at far right, quiet low access covers. Clear practical logistics, no boxes in front of the wall or readable text.

Science medical bay: warm pale enamel and muted medical blue seams, compact capped oxygen and suction outlets with distinct shapes at far left, closed sterile supply dispenser at far right, fine clean lower air-return grille. Calm clean treatment infrastructure, no red crosses, beds or monitors occupying the clear panels.

Life Support biodome: pale sage-gray pressure panels and subtle warm composite lower trim, small humidity and air-quality gauge at far left, neatly closed irrigation access hatch and one tiny healthy leaf sprig in a fitted end holder at far right. Restored living habitat, no foliage over the future window panels and no glass dome baked in.

Anomaly xenobiology lab: precise gray pressure steel with a few desaturated violet seal accents, far-left double-isolated sample-transfer fitting, far-right compact containment pressure dials and sealed glove-port cover. Unfamiliar specimens suggested by equipment only, no visible creatures, tentacles, glowing liquids or contamination.

Anomaly laboratory: dark neutral steel and muted plum insulated seam pieces, recessed asymmetric calibration sockets at far left, shielded sensor coil housing and a tiny unlit meter at far right, sparse lower vent perforations. Quiet experimental unease, no occult symbols, neon, stars or cracks.

Science biological laboratory: clean pale cabinetry-like enamel wall panels, muted blue instrument markings, far-left small capped sterile sample manifold, far-right compact slide-case holder and washable utility couplers, fine low filtered vents. Functional everyday science, no contamination or large cultures covering reservations.

Operations command center: charcoal and medium gray structural panels with restrained muted burgundy service identifiers, compact recessed intercom grille and handset dock at far left, closed security access box and analog station-status dial at far right. Ordered control-room identity, no wide screens, glowing displays or warning stripes across center.

Neutral gray transit corridor: straightforward gray marine pressure panels, small recessed emergency intercom at far left, compact flush route-sign holder with blank insert at far right, protected low cable channel. Minimal fittings and clear sightlines, no colored department wash or decorative clutter.

Neutral gray turning corridor: robust gray pressure steel, far-left flush emergency tool cover and compact protected service elbow, far-right recessed corner inspection plate with restrained fasteners, low quiet conduit trim. Design as one straight reusable wall segment for an L-shaped host, not a painted perspective corner; keep central and side reservations.

Engineering pressure control: dull gray reinforced pressure plates, vertically stacked paired analog dials with a protected brass valve at far left, short regulator manifold and sealed inspection cover at far right, lower fine relief vent. Practical underwater pressure management, not a submarine cockpit or bright safety-yellow wall.

Robotics listening post: muted charcoal acoustic wall panels, small recessed hydrophone test connectors at far left, compact analog signal meter and dark acoustic grille at far right, restrained cyan identifiers. Quiet underwater listening machinery, no large screens or visible sound-wave glow.

Anomaly isolation vault: substantial neutral gray layered pressure panels, desaturated violet gasket tabs, far-left double-contained lock inspection covers, far-right recessed mechanical pressure telltale and capped isolated service port. Quiet serious containment, no prison bars, cracks, hazard spectacle or supernatural glow.

Neutral gray junction corridor: marine-gray interchangeable pressure panels, far-left compact emergency direction-marker holder with blank inserts, far-right three protected service junction plugs, understated low vent strip. Distinct organized junction servicing, straight wall segment for a T-shaped host, no baked angled walls or signs in door/window reservations.

Recreation crew lounge: warm muted wood panel inserts and beige acoustic fabric sections within dark pressure-steel ribs, small fitted book shelf low on far left, a compact unlit warm reading-lamp housing and personal keepsake holder at far right. Comfortable shared refuge with dull brass small joints, no furniture or clutter in center/window panels.

Robotics holographic core: matte dark steel and muted cyan precision trim, recessed optical service lens housing at far left, closed projector calibration cassette and shielded data jacks at far right, fine lower cooling vents. Practical advanced optical hardware, no projected hologram or luminous strips baked into base art.

Engineering maintenance bay: gray replaceable steel panels with small restrained ochre markings, fitted spanner and driver rack at far left, short neatly secured service hose with capped ends at far right, low parts-access covers. Organized useful repair wall, restrained handling wear, no loose cables or floor equipment.

Science medical center: clean warm pale enamel with muted blue clinical identifiers, a compact wall diagnostic dock and capped gas outlets at far left, sealed supply dispenser and small filtered vent at far right, low hygienic kick rail. More equipped than med bay but all large central and side reservations remain empty; no beds or people.

Science medical office: warm pale panels with muted blue-gray acoustic inserts and a narrow warm wood lower trim, small closed medical-file pocket at far left, unlit task-light housing and intercom at far right. Quiet consultation space, restrained comfortable materials, no readable personal records or large charts on reserved panels.

Robotics radio lab: dark gray steel with muted cyan insulated terminals, small fitted coaxial patch sockets and short secured cable at far left, analog tuning dial and shielded connector cover at far right, lower small heat vents. Tactile retro-futurist communications, no antenna mast, waveform screens or glowing lights.

Engineering shield generator: dark gray reinforced steel with muted blue-gray insulated access plates, far-left protected field-coil service couplings, far-right compact mechanical load dial and closed high-current disconnect cover, low cooling grille. Heavy dependable underwater protection hardware, no energy shield or baked glow.
